newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Lippo Life 1996 net up to 66 bln rph.
newsitem.headline: Lippo Life 1996 net up to 66 bln rph.

text.p: Indonesian insurance company PT Asuransi Lippo Life said on Wednesday its 1996 net income rose sharply to almost 66 billion rupiah against 20.1 billion rupiah in the previous year.
The company said in a statement its pre-tax profit rose 300 percent to 67.2 billion rupiah in 1996 from 22.1 billion rupiah in 1995.
It said it booked total revenues of 624.2 billion rupiah in 1996 and this was expected to reach 845 billion rupiah in 1997.
Lippo added it expected its net income to reach 130.8 billion rupiah in 1997 with earnings per share of 340 rupiah, or a 100 percent higher than its 1996 earnings per share of 170 rupiah.
The statement, which said the results were audited, did not provide any details further or a precise figure for its net income.
